name: Rewrite: Oka-ken Katsudou Kiroku Gaiden
original_name: Rewrite オカ研活動記録外伝
source: Rewrite: Oka-ken Katsudou Kiroku Gaiden is an episodic release of Rewrite stories which was released with DVD and Blu-ray Disc volumes for the anime.
translation: 《Rewrite：学生会活动记录外传》是由动画DVD及蓝光碟各卷附带发行的《Rewrite》故事集，每卷收录一个短篇。
